svg.title: VibeX 一体化 Agent-Native 开发平台全景图
svg.desc: VibeX unites 20+ coding agents with free-form tabs and infinite spatial canvas, multi-worktree engineering, 3-tier agent collaboration, everything-is-a-plugin Vibe Coding tools, and multi-Host connectivity across Desktop, WebUI, Server, Mobile, and IM.
